{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]

# Count how many unique patients have duplicates
num_duplicate_patients = duplicate_patients['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check sample_seq for these patients
duplicate_summary = duplicate_patients.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Print results
print(f"Number of patients with duplicate entries: {num_duplicate_patients}")
print(f"Maximum sample_seq per patient with duplicates: {duplicate_summary.max()}")
print(f"All max sample_seq values are equal to the max across all patients: {duplicate_summary.max() == data['sample_seq'].max()}")"}
